description: Adapting the agent-session flow to be specifically tailored for creating presentations in Slidev or PowerPoint, based on lessons learned from the agent-skills-presentation session

high_level: Streamlined presentation workflow that matches the linear nature of slide creation vs. adaptive coding
mid_level: SPEC: Interview focused purely on key idea - no research
PLAN: Output as file tree showing slide structure (the storyboard)
BUILD: Two modes - full draft (entire presentation) or single slide (iterate on one)

key_decisions.decision: Simplify the workflow to match presentation linearity
key_decisions.rationale: Presentations are more predictable than code - once you know what each slide should do, it's mostly template application. The generic agent-session is overkill.
Keep it simple - SPEC just captures the key idea. External data/reports provided manually by user when needed.

key_decisions.decision: PLAN is pseudo-structured free-form file tree with optional template
key_decisions.rationale: Primary purpose is bird's eye view of what you're saying. Template helps BUILD but user may not know which templates are available.
No PowerPoint support - built for Slidev template system in this repo.

key_decisions.decision: Two BUILD modes: full draft and single slide
key_decisions.rationale: Full draft generates entire presentation. Single slide mode for iterating on specific slides.
Core questions as guide (audience, takeaway, time, non-goals) but flows naturally, adapts to conversation.
